summary: A10 Networks filed an 8-K on August 5, 2026, reporting Q2 2026 results and announcing a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per share payable September 1, 2026 to holders of record August 17, 2026. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement, not a special-situation event such as a capital return program, tender offer, or strategic transaction. No M&A, activism, restructuring, or other extraordinary corporate action is disclosed. The dividend is a standard recurring distribution subject to board review. No deal terms apply.
